comment: Ratify CLI (non-Kubernetes) config for verifying Brewlet managed-dependency
attestations, e.g. in CI: `ratify verify -s <image@sha256:...> -c config.json`.
The plugin binary must be installed at ~/.ratify/plugins/brewlet-managed-dependencies.
The registry must expose the OCI 1.1 Referrers API, and the image must be digest-pinned.
Ratify v1.4.5 supports this inline Rego policy in CLI mode.
Keep its rule aligned with deploy/30-ratify-policy.yaml: one complete valid
Brewlet attestation verified by brewlet-managed-dependencies is required.
Old-key or invalid extra candidates cannot grant or block a valid candidate.
In CI require the JSON result's isSuccess == true; CLI exit status alone is insufficient.

plugin.name: regoPolicy
plugin.policy:
package ratify.policy

default valid := false

valid {
  some i
  report := input.verifierReports[i]
  report.artifactType == "application/vnd.brewlet.attestation.v1+json"
  some j
  vr := report.verifierReports[j]
  vr.verifierName == "brewlet-managed-dependencies"
  vr.isSuccess == true
}
